import sys, json, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from protocol import validate
from te.session import run_case
import gen as G
rng=random.Random(3)
nodes=20
pairs=[(u,v) for u in range(nodes) for v in range(nodes) if u!=v]
rng.shuffle(pairs)
edges=[[u,v,rng.choice([7,13,29,97])] for (u,v) in pairs[:64]]
adj={n:[] for n in range(nodes)}
for eid,(u,v,c) in enumerate(edges): adj[u].append((eid,v))
coms=[]
for k in range(24):
    s=rng.randrange(nodes); t=rng.randrange(nodes)
    while t==s: t=rng.randrange(nodes)
    slots=[]; used=set()
    for _ in range(8):
        w=G.random_walk(adj,s,t,rng)
        if w is None or tuple(w) in used: slots.append(None)
        else: used.add(tuple(w)); slots.append(w)
    coms.append({"source":s,"sink":t,"demand":1000,"paths":slots})
print("slots total", sum(len(c['paths']) for c in coms), "nonnull", sum(1 for c in coms for p in c['paths'] if p is not None))
ws=[[] for _ in range(8)]
for i,k in enumerate(range(24)): ws[i%8].append(k)
for w in ws: w.sort()
events=[{"op":"issue","id":i,"worker":i%8} for i in range(8)]+[{"op":"deliver","id":i} for i in range(8)]+[{"op":"step"}]+[{"op":"audit"} for _ in range(240)]
case={"nodes":nodes,"edges":edges,"commodities":coms,"workers":ws,"quorum":4,"max_lag":12,"relax":[3,2],"rho":8,"mode":"route","events":events}
req={"cases":[case]}
validate(req)
t=time.time(); resp={"cases":[run_case(case)]}; print("time %.2f"%(time.time()-t))
out=json.dumps(resp,separators=(',',':'))
print("output bytes", len(out), "=", round(len(out)/1048576.0,3), "MiB")
import verify as V
print("errors", V.verify(req,resp) or "none")
EOF
